title: Seattle, WA — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Seattle, WA: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Seattle is a city in WA with a population of 755,078. Pacific Northwest tech hub with no state income tax, coffee culture, and stunning nature. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 8b growing zone supports Warm — citrus, avocados, tomatoes, peppers. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
